title: OTTERNET / Services
description: Every service request, from the branch it was asked on to its health once deployed: requested (with its proposed change's validators), merged, deployed to every device, healthy, and removed. Nothing here names a service or a kind: new ones appear because they exist, and what is checked for each is a monitoring profile in Infrahub.

list.name: kind
list.label: Kind
list.description: Service kinds the lifecycle exporter reports -- every kind there is, including one added tomorrow.

list.name: owner
list.label: Owner
list.description: The organisation that ordered the service.

list.name: Service events
list.expr: max by (service_kind, service, event, status) (otternet_service_event_timestamp_seconds{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service"}) * 1000

panels.title: The pipeline, now -- a request moves left to right; red is something stuck
Requested
panels.description: Services on a branch whose proposed change is open: new, changed or deleted relative to main.

targets.expr: count(otternet_service_stage{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service", owner=~"$owner", stage="requested"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Validators failing
panels.description: Open requests whose proposed change has a failed validator. Merging is the approval; this one should not be.

targets.expr: count(otternet_service_stage{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service", owner=~"$owner", stage="requested", validation="failed"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Merged, not yet deployed
panels.description: On main and live, while some device the reconciler tracks has not been confirmed in sync since the service last changed.

targets.expr: count(otternet_service_stage{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service", owner=~"$owner", stage="merged"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Deployed
panels.description: On main, live, and every tracked device confirmed in sync since the service last changed.

targets.expr: count(otternet_service_stage{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service", owner=~"$owner", stage="deployed"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Removed (24h)
panels.description: Services deleted from main in the last day.

panels.title: Every service, and where it is
Requests and services by stage
panels.description: One row per service per stage it is in, from the service-lifecycle exporter. A service on main with a request open against it appears twice: once deployed on main, once requested on its branch. 'In stage' is how long it has been there.

targets.expr: max by (service_kind, service, owner, requester, stage, status, branch, proposed_change, change, validation) (otternet_service_stage{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service", owner=~"$owner"} * on (service_kind, service, stage, branch) group_left () (time() - max by (service_kind, service, stage, branch) (otternet_service_stage_since_timestamp_seconds)))

panels.title: Over time -- created, merged and removed are annotations
Services by stage
panels.description: How many services sit at each stage. A request appears as a blue band and turns into a deployed one when its merge reaches every device.

targets.expr: count by (stage) (otternet_service_stage{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service", owner=~"$owner"})

panels.title: Services on main, by kind and status
panels.description: Every service on main, by kind and status. A revoke shows as a status change and then a step down.

targets.expr: count by (service_kind, status) (otternet_service_stage{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service", owner=~"$owner", branch="main", stage!="removed"})

panels.title: Applications: pods ready and VIP assigned
panels.description: Every watched application: ready replicas in its namespace (the kubelet's own probes, which the composed pod policy admits as host), and the LoadBalancer address Cilium assigned from its block.

targets.expr: max by (service, namespace) (otternet_intended_service_workload{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service"}) * on (namespace) group_left () sum by (namespace) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available)
max by (service, namespace, vip_block) (otternet_intended_service_vip{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service"})

panels.title: Assigned VIPs
panels.description: The LoadBalancer addresses kube-state-metrics reports in each watched application's namespace.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, service, ip) (kube_service_status_load_balancer_ingress and on (namespace) otternet_intended_service_vip{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service"})

panels.title: Probed ports answering
panels.description: A: ports the collector probes (only where an application's pod gate admits it). B: of those, answering now. The seeded applications are all gated, so 0 probes is the expected reading here.

targets.expr: count(otternet_intended_service_probe{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service"}) or vector(0)
count(net_response_result_code{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service"} == 0)

panels.title: Routed services: sessions realising each
panels.description: Per service, the BGP sessions Infrahub says realise it (from the WAN sites and peerings it names, or the sessions its VRF holds on the fabric) and how many the devices report Established.

targets.expr: count by (service_kind, service) (otternet_intended_service_bgp{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service"})

count by (service_kind, service) (otternet_intended_service_bgp{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service"} and on (device, peer_address) (label_replace(bgp_neighbor_session_state_code, "peer_address", "$1", "neighbor_address", "(.*)") == 6))

panels.title: Routed services: sessions down
panels.description: Sessions that realise a service and are not Established, per service. Flat zero is healthy.

panels.title: Grant rules on a confirmed firewall
panels.description: A: firewall rules access grants materialised. B: of those, on a firewall whose DeploymentState is in sync. No grant is seeded, so 0 is the expected reading until someone asks.

targets.expr: count(otternet_intended_service_access{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service"}) or vector(0)

count(otternet_intended_service_access{service_kind=~"$kind", service=~"$service"} and on (firewall) label_replace(infrahub_deploymentstate_info{status="in_sync"}, "firewall", "$1", "name", "(.*)")) or vector(0)
